notes: Ports pulled verbatim from Yamaha USA's official CP88/CP73 spec table (fetched and grepped from raw HTML, TLS-verified, 2026-07-31). Confirmed connectors: 6.3mm (1/4") TS phone jacks for unbalanced L/MONO+R line outs and AUX L/MONO+R inputs, XLR3 for balanced line outs, 6.3mm stereo phone jack (TRS) for headphones, 5-pin DIN MIDI In/Out, USB-B (TO HOST, doubles as USB audio/MIDI interface) and USB-A (TO DEVICE) ports. Not explicitly specified by Yamaha and therefore inferred/lower-confidence: (1) foot controller/footswitch jack types (TRS vs TS) — assigned TRS to FOOT CONTROLLER 1/2 and FOOT SWITCH SUSTAIN (continuous-sensing use cases, matching the bundled FC3A half-damper pedal) and TS to FOOT SWITCH ASSIGNABLE (simple on/off); (2) AC IN inlet standard — spec table only shows the label "[AC IN]" with a separate detachable "Power cord x 1" listed in box contents, so an IEC (C13/14) inlet was assumed rather than a captive cord; (3) no USB speed (e.g. USB 2.0) is published by Yamaha for either USB port, so grade was omitted per instructions. Desktop stage-piano form factor, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). No listed "type" enum value fits a musical instrument/stage piano, so "Other" was used; category set to "audio" as the closest fit. Yamaha's official CP88 owner's manual PDF link found in search results returned 404 and was not used to cross-check.

ports.name: FOOT CONTROLLER [1]
ports.note: Continuous foot controller jack; TRS inferred (needed for continuous-controller pedals like FC7), not explicitly stated by Yamaha

ports.name: FOOT CONTROLLER [2]
ports.note: Continuous foot controller jack; TRS inferred, not explicitly stated by Yamaha

ports.name: FOOT SWITCH [SUSTAIN]
ports.note: TRS inferred to support half-damper continuous sensing with the bundled FC3A pedal; not explicitly stated by Yamaha

ports.name: FOOT SWITCH [ASSIGNABLE]
ports.note: TS inferred for simple on/off footswitch; not explicitly stated by Yamaha

ports.name: USB [TO HOST]
ports.note: Carries MIDI and USB audio interface data; no USB speed grade published

ports.name: USB [TO DEVICE]
ports.note: For USB storage devices; no USB speed grade published

ports.name: INPUT [R]
ports.note: AUX audio input, standard phone jack

ports.name: AC IN
